description: Resolve a plain-language place or airline name into the codes the search tools need. Use kind='airport' for flight origins and destinations (returns IATA airport codes such as LHR, and city codes such as LON that cover every airport in a metro area), kind='airline' for two-letter carrier codes, kind='hotelLocation' for a hotel search location id, and kind='carLocation' for a rental pickup location id. Flight searches take the code field; hotel and car searches take the locationId field, which is a numeric string and not a city name. Resolve an ambiguous name here instead of guessing a code. Costs one API request against the account's monthly quota. Starting a search and reading each page are separate requests.

country.description: Two-letter market code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) biasing results, for example 'GB'.

kind.description: What to resolve. Flight searches need 'airport'; hotel and car searches need 'hotelLocation' and 'carLocation'.

query.description: Place, airport, or airline name, for example 'London' or 'Delta'.

type.description: For kind='carLocation' only: narrow to city centres or airports.

name: ktemia_lookup
title: Look up airport, airline, or location codes
